channel.title: Sermonship
channel.description: Updates for Sermonship, the free sermon-to-everything app for the Mac.

item.title: Sermonship 0.2.0
item.description:
Sermonship 0.2.0

  • Ask for what you need. Each sermon's page now has Videos, Images and Documents workspaces, each with a Create Custom button: describe the clip, the quote card or the document you want in a sentence and Sermonship reads the whole sermon and makes it. Clips take a length (short, standard or long) and can be cut from a passage you choose; documents follow the brief, however small; cards come at any shape on any background.
  • About twice as fast with the built-in writing model. The sermon is transcribed on the Mac's GPU, the clips are cut while the documents are being written, and the model thinks for as long as each step needs rather than longer. A one-hour sermon now takes about ten minutes on a recent Mac.
  • Smaller things: a short highlight list is asked for again instead of being accepted; the shape picker shows a preview; custom cards no longer count as part of the quote-card set; the workspaces fit the window at its smallest size.

item.title: Sermonship 0.1.1
item.description:
Sermonship 0.1.1

  • Quote cards: a ✦ button in the card editor draws four more designed backgrounds in your colours; "New Designs" above the cards redraws the whole set (with Undo).
  • My Backgrounds: photos you choose are kept in your Sermonship folder and offered again next time; right-click a designed background to keep it too.
  • The log (Help › Show Logs) now records what Sermonship found on launch, to make problems easier to report.

item.title: Sermonship 0.1.0
item.description:
Sermonship 0.1.0

The first release, for a small group of testers.

  • Everything from one recording: transcript, two summaries, ten discussion questions, five daily devotionals, quotes and quote cards, and vertical highlight clips with and without subtitles.
  • Writes on your Mac with a model it downloads once; or with your own Gemini key.
  • Choose the whole suite or just some of it, and add more later, including more clips.
  • Ask the Sermon: questions, drafts and a clip about any subject, from the transcript.
  • Customise: card shape, backgrounds, theme colour, logo (with strength), speaker name, your own notes to the writer.
